dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Actually, I don't think there's much point continuing that game... I'm pretty sure I don't have a chance of winning.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Hehe, well, I've forgotten where we left off amidst the activity of the past few days. Don't you want to take this opportunity to try and best me for once?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: If you say so... alright, I'll give it my best shot!

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Please take note that the announcement concerning the marriage between Sir Kujou Kamaji and Lady Hiiragi Chisato has been found to have been released in error due to a miscommunication within the Kanjou Commission. We sincerely apologize for any subsequent confusion or misunderstandings.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: The staff involved have been held to severe account, and the Shogunate wishes again to emphasize the importance of communication and discipline.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Let it be known that the matrimonial ceremonies have been delayed, and that further details will become available at a later date.
